metadata.unit: MODIS-equivalent hot spots (Terra + Aqua, vegetation fires, confidence >= 30 / nominal)

model.countEngine: v2 base (nominal years) + VIIRS chain + MODIS drift law
model.unit: MODIS (Terra + Aqua) hot spots on nominal orbits (as before 2020), vegetation fires

metadata.license: NASA FIRMS, US Government public domain

validation.design: blocked 4-fold over years; each fold refits the nominal efficiencies, the VIIRS chain and the MODIS drift law on the other years and predicts raw MODIS from VIIRS alone through the drift law
validation.intervalNote: the multiplier is calibrated on these folds, so the calibrated coverage is in-sample

thresholdLayer.note: explanatory layer only; the official harmonized count comes from the efficiency model
